name: trapz
title: Trapezoidal Integration
description: Area under sampled values by the trapezoidal rule, including the polygon form used for complex inputs.
case: sin on 11 points from 0 to pi
r: trapz(seq(0, pi, length.out=11), sin(seq(0, pi, length.out=11)))
args: Abscissae, or the ordinates when y is omitted.
Ordinates. Omitted, x is integrated against 1, 2, ...

name: cumtrapz
title: Trapezoidal Integration
description: Cumulative trapezoidal integral down each column.
case: sin and squares on uneven abscissae
args: Abscissae, or the ordinates when y is omitted.

name: trapzfun
title: Trapezoidal Integration
description: Iterated trapezoidal rule for a function on a finite interval.
py: np.array([trapzfun(lambda t: t**2, 0, 1)[k] for k in ('value', 'iter', 'rel.err')])

name: simpson
title: Simpson Integration
description: Composite Simpson's 1/3 rule. n must be even.
case: sin from 0 to pi with 20 panels

name: simpson2d
title: Double Simpson Integration
description: Simpson's rule on a rectangle. Odd panel counts are raised by one.
usage: simpson2d(f, xa, xb, ya, yb, nx = 128, ny = 128, ...)
case: x^2 + y^2 on [-1, 1] x [-1, 1] with 8 by 8 panels
r: simpson2d(function(x, y) x^2 + y^2, -1, 1, -1, 1, nx=8, ny=8)
py: np.array([simpson2d(lambda x, y: x**2 + y**2, -1, 1, -1, 1, nx=8, ny=8)])
args: Vectorized function of x and y.

name: simpadpt
title: Adaptive Simpson's Rule
description: Adaptive Simpson rule with one Romberg step, started from unequal subintervals.

name: cotes
title: Newton-Cotes Formulas
description: Closed composite Newton-Cotes formulas of degree 2 to 8.
case: sin from 0 to pi/2, 20 steps, 5 nodes

name: romberg
title: Romberg Integration
description: Romberg table built from the trapezoidal rule.
case: sin from 0 to pi at tolerance 1e-8
r: with(romberg(sin, 0, pi, tol=1e-8), c(value, iter, rel.error))
py: np.array([romberg(np.sin, 0, math.pi, tol=1e-8)[k] for k in ('value', 'iter', 'rel.error')])

name: quad
title: Adaptive Simpson Quadrature
description: Adaptive Simpson quadrature on a finite interval.
usage: quad(f, xa, xb, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5, trace = FALSE, ...)

name: quadl
title: Adaptive Lobatto Quadrature
description: Adaptive Lobatto quadrature on a finite interval.
usage: quadl(f, xa, xb, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5, trace = FALSE, ...)

name: quadv
title: Vectorized Integration
description: Adaptive Simpson integration of a vector-valued integrand.
case: sin and cos from 0 to pi, with the function count
r: with(quadv(function(t) c(sin(t), cos(t)), 0, pi), c(Q, fcnt, estim.prec))
py: (lambda d: np.concatenate([d['Q'], np.array([d['fcnt'], d['estim.prec']])]))(quadv(lambda t: np.array([np.sin(t), np.cos(t)]), 0, math.pi))

name: quadgr
title: Gaussian Quadrature with Richardson Extrapolation
description: 12-point Gauss quadrature with Richardson extrapolation.

name: quadgk
title: Adaptive Gauss-Kronrod Quadrature
description: Adaptive 7- and 15-point Gauss-Kronrod quadrature.

name: gauss_kronrod
title: Gauss-Kronrod Quadrature
description: One panel of the 7- and 15-point Gauss-Kronrod rule.

name: quadcc
title: Adaptive Clenshaw-Curtis Quadrature
description: Adaptive Clenshaw-Curtis quadrature. Reversed limits are sent to quadgk.

name: clenshaw_curtis
title: Clenshaw-Curtis Quadrature Formula
description: Clenshaw-Curtis quadrature from a Chebyshev expansion and an FFT.
case: sin from 0 to pi with 16 panels

name: quad2d
title: 2-d Gaussian Quadrature
description: Tensor product of Gauss-Legendre rules on a rectangle.
usage: quad2d(f, xa, xb, ya, yb, n = 32, ...)
case: x*y on the unit square with 6 nodes
args: Vectorized function of x and y.

name: quadinf
title: Infinite Integrals
description: Iterative quadrature after mapping a finite, half-infinite, or infinite interval to (-1, 1).
r: with(quadinf(function(t) exp(-t^2), 0, Inf), c(Q, relerr, niter))
py: np.array([quadinf(lambda t: np.exp(-(t**2)), 0, np.inf)[k] for k in ('Q', 'relerr', 'niter')])

name: integral2
title: Numerically Evaluate Double and Triple Integrals
description: Adaptive tensor-product Gauss-Kronrod rule on a rectangle, with optional polar sector coordinates.
usage: integral2(fun, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, sector = FALSE, reltol = 1e-6, abstol = 0, maxlist = 5000, singular = FALSE, vectorized = TRUE, ...)
case: cos(x) cos(y) on the unit square
py: np.array([integral2(lambda x, y: np.cos(x)*np.cos(y), 0, 1, 0, 1)[k] for k in ('Q', 'error')])
args: Lower y limit, or a function of x.
Upper y limit, or a function of x.
Use the singular change of variables.

name: integral
title: Adaptive Numerical Integration
description: Splits the interval and applies Gauss-Kronrod, Clenshaw-Curtis, or adaptive Simpson. Infinite limits use quadinf.
usage: integral(fun, xmin, xmax, method = c('Kronrod', 'Clenshaw', 'Simpson'), no_intervals = 8, random = FALSE, reltol = 1e-8, abstol = 0, ...)
case: sin from 0 to pi by Kronrod on 4 pieces
args: Kronrod, Clenshaw, or Simpson. A unique prefix is enough.
Place the interior breaks at random.

name: dblquad
title: Double and Triple Integration
description: Nested adaptive quadrature over a rectangle. dim chooses which variable is inner.
usage: dblquad(f, xa, xb, ya, yb, dim = 2, ..., subdivs = 300, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5)
args: Vectorized function of x and y.
2 integrates y first, 1 integrates x first.
Subdivision limit passed to the inner integrator.

name: triquad
title: Gaussian Triangle Quadrature
description: Gauss quadrature over a triangle given by three vertices.
r: triquad(function(x, y) x^2 + y^2, c(-1, 1, 0), c(0, 0, 1), n=6)
args: Three x coordinates of the vertices.
Three y coordinates of the vertices.

name: line_integral
title: Line integral (in the complex plane)
description: Complex line integral along straight segments between waypoints.
case: 1/z around the rectangle with corners -i, 1, i, -1
args: NULL uses adaptive quadrature. Otherwise a method for integral.

name: integral3
title: Numerically Evaluate Double and Triple Integrals
description: Triple integral reduced to integral2 in y and z, then integrated in x.
usage: integral3(fun, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax, reltol = 1e-6, ...)
args: Integrand of x, y, and z.
Lower y limit, or a function of x.
Upper y limit, or a function of x.
Lower z limit, or a function of x and y.
Upper z limit, or a function of x and y.

name: triplequad
title: Double and Triple Integration
description: Triple integral as a double integral of an inner integral in x.
usage: triplequad(f, xa, xb, ya, yb, za, zb, subdivs = 300, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5, ...)
case: y sin(x) + z cos(x) on [0, pi] x [0, 1] x [-1, 1]
r: triplequad(function(x, y, z) y*sin(x) + z*cos(x), 0, pi, 0, 1, -1, 1)
py: np.array([triplequad(lambda x, y, z: y*np.sin(x) + z*np.cos(x), 0, math.pi, 0, 1, -1, 1)])
args: Integrand of x, y, and z.
Tolerance for the outer double integral.

name: gaussLegendre
title: Gauss-Legendre Quadrature Formula
description: Nodes and weights for the n-point Gauss-Legendre rule on [a, b].

name: gaussHermite
title: Gauss-Hermite Quadrature Formula
description: Nodes and weights for the n-point Gauss-Hermite rule, weight exp(-x^2).

name: gaussLaguerre
title: Gauss-Laguerre Quadrature Formula
description: Nodes and weights for the n-point Gauss-Laguerre rule, weight x^a exp(-x).
